description: This file defines the SparkConf class and related configuration management for Apache Spark, including configuration setting, retrieval, deprecation handling, validation, and serialization registration.

classes.name: ReadOnlySparkConf
classes.description: Trait providing read-only access to Spark configuration parameters with various getter methods.

classes.name: SparkConf
classes.description: Class for configuring Spark applications, supporting setting, retrieving, validation, and serialization of configuration parameters.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieve a configuration parameter as a String, or throw if not set.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieve a configuration parameter with a default value.

methods.name: get[T]
methods.description: Retrieve a pre-defined configuration entry of type T.

methods.name: getTimeAsSeconds
methods.description: Get a time parameter in seconds, throwing if not set.

methods.name: getTimeAsSeconds
methods.description: Get a time parameter in seconds with a default fallback.

methods.name: getTimeAsMs
methods.description: Get a time parameter in milliseconds, throwing if not set.

methods.name: getTimeAsMs
methods.description: Get a time parameter in milliseconds with a default fallback.

methods.name: getSizeAsBytes
methods.description: Get a size parameter in bytes, throwing if not set.

methods.name: getSizeAsBytes
methods.description: Get a size parameter in bytes with a default fallback.

methods.name: getSizeAsBytes
methods.description: Get a size parameter in bytes with a default Long value.

methods.name: getSizeAsKb
methods.description: Get a size parameter in Kibibytes, throwing if not set.

methods.name: getSizeAsKb
methods.description: Get a size parameter in Kibibytes with a default fallback.

methods.name: getSizeAsMb
methods.description: Get a size in Mebibytes, throwing if not set.

methods.name: getSizeAsMb
methods.description: Get a size in Mebibytes with a default fallback.

methods.name: getSizeAsGb
methods.description: Get a size in Gibibytes, throwing if not set.

methods.name: getSizeAsGb
methods.description: Get a size in Gibibytes with a default fallback.

methods.name: getOption
methods.description: Retrieve an optional configuration parameter.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieve all configuration parameters as an array of key-value pairs.

methods.name: getInt
methods.description: Retrieve an integer configuration parameter with a default.

methods.name: getLong
methods.description: Retrieve a long configuration parameter with a default.

methods.name: getDouble
methods.description: Retrieve a double configuration parameter with a default.

methods.name: getBoolean
methods.description: Retrieve a boolean configuration parameter with a default.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Check if a key exists in the configuration.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Create a deep copy of the SparkConf object.

methods.name: validateSettings
methods.description: Validate configuration settings, throw exceptions for invalid configs.

methods.name: toDebugString
methods.description: Return a string listing all configuration keys and values for debugging.
